justifications.unit: Unit tests drive both fixtures and every webhook extension against an in-process WireMock server; only the Docker-backed WireMockContainerFixture start-up is left to the integration flag (#2651).
justifications.guard: Guard tests cover the argument and not-initialized checks of the fixtures, a small share of the lines (#2651).

justifications.unit: Without Docker only the not-initialized paths and DisposeAsync run in unit tests; start-up, client creation and reset need a container and run in the integration flag (#2651).
justifications.guard: The container fixture has no argument checks; its state checks are covered by unit tests (#2651).
